units.source_text: 难道就没有可以攀登的地方吗？

en.t: Was there really nowhere he could climb?

units.source_text: 他在房子周围绕了两三圈。

en.t: He circled the house two or three times.

units.source_text: 临海的北侧，要是爬上屋顶，到洞口的距离倒是最短的。

en.t: On the north side facing the sea, if he climbed onto the roof, the distance to the mouth of the hole would be the shortest.

units.source_text: 可即使爬上屋顶，离洞口还有十多米，而那段沙壁又是最陡峭的。

en.t: But even from the roof, the opening was still more than ten meters away, and that stretch of sand wall was the steepest.

units.source_text: 再加上沉甸甸垂下的沙檐，岌岌可危。

en.t: On top of that, the heavy overhanging lip of sand looked ready to collapse at any moment.
